title: security: DAO origin validation not consolidated
close_reason: Fixed: Consolidated DAO origin validation in Rust to match Python reference. Created rust/lichen-rpl/src/dao_origin.rs with: DaoOriginRejectReason enum (all 9 spec-defined rejection reasons), DaoOriginResult struct (valid/is_fresh/reject_reason/pubkey/origin_sequence/dao_digest), PinTable and OriginReplayStore traits, DaoOriginValidator with single validate() method combining signature verification and replay checks. Re-exported from routing.rs for backward compatibility. Python implementation was already consolidated - no changes needed.
